verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a hosted, branded status page on your own custom subdomain via a single CNAME record. Customers can subscribe to email updates for the whole page or selected components. The status-page product page also lists monitor types and integrations with Datadog, Grafana, and others, which implies the page is fed by monitoring. missing for 10: explicit documentation that status page state and updates are driven automatically from incident state, notification channels beyond email for subscribers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
